thread:
Marta (product): quick design check — we've got three outstanding decisions for the compact rollout row: 1) verb choice ('Hold' vs 'Pause' vs 'Freeze'), 2) whether to inline 'Create snapshot' before any hold/rollback, and 3) how the undo/rollback toast should surface op-ids and progress. mock: https://figma.redwood/compact-rollout-lexicon-v1
Omar (design): short take: 'Hold' feels clearest to non-eng folks. 'Pause' sounds temporary but some teams think that implies automated resumption. 'Freeze' is too extreme. If we use 'Hold', microcopy must say "Hold stops new traffic; it does not revert." Also propose a tiny secondary link 'Snapshot' instead of a full button to reduce visual weight.
Lin (frontend): implementation notes: inline snapshot-as-link is easy; keyboard: snapshot must be tabbable. For rollback we should use an inline confirm popover (not modal) with 'Rollback' and 'Cancel' and then an undo toast for 10s: "Rollback started — Undo". Toast should include op-id if backend provides it.
Vikas (eng-runtime): backend will return an op id and estimated duration when available. We can include: "op-2519 (ETA ~75s)" in the toast and expose a link to operation logs. Important: rollback is async and may touch multiple regions; UX should never imply instant completion. Also +1 on confirmation for >50% traffic changes.
Noor (a11y): SR guidance: when state changes (Held, Snapshot created, Rollback started) announce with role=status and aria-live=polite. For rollback initiation use role=alertdialog and aria-live=assertive so SR users are interrupted. Make sure the undo toast is reachable by keyboard and announced as a status with the op id. Provide a hidden summary for quick timeline updates: "v5.4 held at 40% — snapshot saved".
Marta (product): copy options (vote):
- Opt A: Primary = "Hold"; secondary inline link = "Snapshot"; overflow = "Rollback to previous"
- Opt B: Primary = "Pause rollout"; secondary = "Create snapshot"; overflow = "Rollback (danger)"
- Opt C: Primary = "Hold + Snapshot"; overflow = "Rollback"
Omar (design): prefer Opt A. keeps primary minimal. UI suggestion: small grey sublabel under the row: "Held 40%  snapshot saved" (we'll replace unicode with a real separator). Also propose a subtle heatline beneath the row to indicate traffic delta between versions — gradient + small chevron to show direction.
Lin (frontend): heatline ok but must have textual fallback: aria-label="Traffic delta +15%". For very narrow rows, swap heatline for "+15%" text. Also ensure color contrast and icon fallback for colorblind users.
Noor (a11y): color alone is insufficient; include an icon aria-hidden and a visually-hidden text node with the state. Also make sure the heatline patterns are detectable without color (dots/stripes).
Vikas (eng-runtime): small practical point: include op-id in both toast and row status: "Rolling back (op-2519) — 40%" so support can click through. Backend can provide progress pings.
Marta (product): quick poll — reply :+1: for Opt A, :heart: Opt B, :thinking_face: other
Omar (design): :+1:
Lin (frontend): :+1:
Vikas (eng-runtime): :heart: (lean B when enterprise wants single-click snapshot)
Noor (a11y): :+1: (Opt A with strong SR copy)
RolloutBot: Snapshot snap-20241112-2519 created for v5.4
Marta (product): action items: 1) Omar update microcopy and add heatline spec 2) Lin implement inline snapshot link + popover confirm + undo toast (include op-id) 3) Vikas ensure op-id + ETA + progress pings in API 4) Noor provide SR copy bundle and pattern tests. I'll post revised mock tomorrow. Thanks!
